title: Daily Game Studio Devlog #37: Neon Gravity Runner - Day 37 — AI Builds & Fixes a Game in 24h
description:
Every day, an AI agent (Hermes) creates a complete HTML5 Canvas game from scratch. But the real engineering story is the self-healing pipeline that tests, finds bugs, and auto-fixes them via NIM API (Nemotron 3 Ultra).

🎮 PLAY Neon Gravity Runner - Day 37: https://dailygamestudio.github.io/daily-games/games/game-037/
📂 SOURCE CODE: https://github.com/dailygamestudio/daily-games/tree/main/games/game-037/
🤖 HERMES AGENT: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Cold Open — Broken vs Fixed
0:15 The Challenge: Variable gravity platformer with gravity flipping, momentum
1:00 The Struggle: 1 Bugs Found
2:30 The Breakthrough: State machine unification: single source of truth for game state, all UI derives from it
3:30 Playtest & Reflection
